Recite these prayers during the nights as ye are witnesses. All your desires shall be fulfilled thereby, if ye believe and are convinced. And whoso hath remembered Me through thy remembrance of Me, and all who remember Me—verily Thou art He Who shall remember them from Thy presence, for Thou art the Best of those who remember. I have become independent of all things through Thee, for Thou art the Most Self-Sufficient of the self-sufficient. Thou hast gained victory over all things, for Thou art the Most Victorious of victors. Through Thee have I triumphed over all things, for Thou art the Best of those who triumph. All names in Paradise remember Thee even as I have remembered Thee, for Thou art the Best of those who hear. Therefore, O God, elevate all to the stations of Thy good-pleasure from Thy presence, for Thou art the Best of those who exalt.
